name: NCAA D-I South Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Tallahassee, FL · host Florida State · Apalachee Regional Park
headline: NCAA D-I South Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Men: No. 4 Alabama, No. 8 Florida and No. 24 Tennessee. Women: No. 4 Alabama and No. 5 Florida. The top two teams and the top four individuals not on those teams qualify automatically for the NCAA Championships on Nov. 21. · Women 6K 8:30 a.m. ET · Men 10K 9:30 a.m. ET
